Maya: FYI legal just requested 24-month retention for auth logs "accessible for audit". Today we keep 90d raw + 1y scrubbed. Need a short design: where to keep 24m, KMS separation, JIT access, and replay throttles.

Diego: high level: separate "forensics-kms" CMK for long-term archive. No auto-unwraps. Unwraps must be ticketed with at least one security approver. For requests >7 days of data require 2 approvers. Also rotate access keys for the unwrap service weekly.

Priya: operational note: provide redacted/searchable replicas for daily analysts (search index), full raw only via timeboxed unwrap to minimize blast radius. Prefer presigned URLs (short TTL) + S3/objstore server-side encryption with CMK. Avoid handing out long-lived creds.

security-bot: New task created: TASK-7782 "24m auth archive access pattern" assigned to Maya. (automated)

oncall-sre: Replay/load concerns: large restores will spike SIEM ingest. Propose default replay throttle 500 ev/s per tenant, require off-peak scheduling for >2M events, and staged manifest exports for >3M events. Connector should honor 429s and backoff. Tag all replay jobs with requestor and ticket id.

Maya: Proposed minimal flow (draft):
1) Request: /archive-request --tenant <t> --start <d> --end <d> --purpose <justification> -> creates ticket with uid
2) Security review (SLA 2 biz days). If >7d or >2M events require 2 approvers
3) If approved: mint ephemeral unwrap token tied to forensics-kms (TTL=4h) scoped to ticket uid and object manifest
4) Streamed unwrap -> temporary presigned download URLs (TTL=15m) OR direct S3->SIEM staged manifest ingestion with rate-limit hooks
5) Emit immutable audit events: who requested, approvers, unwrap token id, manifest id, bytes delivered
6) Token revocation and evidence bundle stored in audit-bucket

CLI example:
```
# create request
/archivereq --tenant=contoso --start=2023-04-01 --end=2023-06-01 --purpose="regulatory audit"
# approve (security op)
/archapprove REQ-2025 --approver=diego --note="legal validated"
```

Security controls: define roles 'forensics_reader' (can view scrubbed replicas/searches) and 'archive_operator' (can request/execute unwraps with approval). Archive_operator grants require ticket link, MFA, and approval audit. Add KMS policy restricting decrypt to unwrap service principal and require ExternalKeyAuthorization with ticket id.

Priya: Implementation bits:
- Presigned GET TTL 15m, download URLs logged to audit-bucket
- Use server-side filters (S3 Select / objstore queries) to avoid full-file transfers whenever possible
- For exports >3M events, force manifest/batch export and require SRE runbook coordination

oncall-sre: Add to runbook:
- Default replay throttle 500 ev/s (configurable per customer with an ops ticket)
- Off-peak window enforcement & automatic queuing for large jobs
- Monitor siem.ingest.error-rate and auto-pause if 5xx/429 exceed threshold

Maya: Action items:
- Maya: write KMS key policy draft for 'forensics-kms' + evidence schema (due 2025-02-03)
- Diego: draft RBAC changes + PR with ticket template (due 2025-01-28)
- Priya: prototype presigned-url flow and S3 Select fallback (due 2025-01-30)
- oncall-sre: update runbook with replay throttles & manifest gating (due 2025-01-25)
- security-bot: create reminders and link TASK-7782 to RFC queue

Please ack.
